# carousel-factory

> Pinterest reference → redraw → 9 slides 4:5 → Telegram HITL → Zernio createPost.

- GitHub: https://github.com/SC32br/carousel-factory
- Author: Sergey Nozdrov (SC32br), https://ns.нейросинк.рф/
- License: MIT
- Docs for publish API: https://docs.zernio.com/

Read this before cloning, wiring env, or answering questions about the repo.
The original Pinterest pin is a third-party image. Redraw it. Do not publish it.

## Product
Dockerized factory for a 9-slide 4:5 social carousel.

Pipeline: fetch a fresh Pinterest pin as visual reference → LLM copy + vision redraw → slice a master frame → send album + caption to Telegram → human taps Publish or Revise → one Zernio `createPost` to several accounts.

Control chat is Telegram. Zernio has no MAX and no VK.

## Stack
- Python 3.11
- Docker / Docker Compose (Chromium and ffmpeg in the image)
- kie.ai: text, vision, redraw, video (`KIE_API_KEY`)
- Zernio API: `createPost`, `GET /api/v1/accounts`
- Telegram Bot API: preview and HITL buttons
- Optional Pinterest cookies file: without it Pinterest throttles search

## Install
```
cp .env.example .env
mkdir -p project/secrets project/runs
docker compose up -d --build
```

Daily run:

```
docker compose --profile daily run --rm daily
```

Host cron, Europe/Moscow 09:00 = 06:00 UTC:

```
0 6 * * * cd /path/to/carousel-factory && docker compose --profile daily run --rm daily
```

Without Docker: Python 3.11, `project/requirements.txt`, Chrome/Chromium in `CHROME_BIN`, ffmpeg in PATH, cwd `project/`.

```
cd project
python -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv/bin/python botd.py
.venv/bin/python run_daily.py run
```

## Required env
See `.env.example`. Empty placeholders only.

- `KIE_API_KEY` - kie.ai
- `ZERNIO_API_KEY` - Zernio Settings → API Keys
- `ZERNIO_TARGETS` - comma-separated `platform:accountId` from `GET /api/v1/accounts`
- `TG_BOT_TOKEN`, `TG_CHAT_IDS` - BotFather + userinfobot
- `PINTEREST_COOKIES_FILE` - cookies for pin search
- `AUTO_PUBLISH` - `0` wait for button (default), `1` post after QA

Instagram: `instagram:ID` in `ZERNIO_TARGETS`, or legacy `ZERNIO_INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT_ID`.
Pinterest pin almost always needs `PINTEREST_BOARD_ID`.
YouTube and video-TikTok need `LIVE_COVER=1` and a live cover file. Skip those two targets if the file is missing.

First 2 connected Zernio accounts are free.

## Platforms
RF first: Telegram, Pinterest, YouTube, TikTok.

Verified in production via Zernio:
- Instagram carousel 2-10, mixed png/mp4, ratio from the first item (4:5)
- Threads image pack

In code, not a separate production run:
- Telegram album up to 10
- Facebook and LinkedIn image packs (platform limit)
- TikTok photoset or one cover video (`tiktokSettings`)
- YouTube one cover video plus `title`
- Pinterest first frame plus `boardId`

Native 9×4:5 carousel fit: Instagram (up to 10 mixed), Telegram album, Facebook/Threads multiphoto.
Elsewhere Zernio remaps via `customMedia` (TikTok photoset or one cover video, YouTube one video, Pinterest one pin, LinkedIn up to 20 images).

Instagram is blocked in RF. Keep it as a target only if the account still opens.

## HITL
After a run the bot sends the slide album and caption.

- Publish (`pub:`) - `createPost` to every target in `ZERNIO_TARGETS`. Optional `TG_PUBLISH_CHAT_ID` restricts who can tap it.
- Revise (`fix:`) - text or voice note, fixer proposes a plan, Apply reruns.

Commands: `/new` extra topic, `/rules` learned rules, `/status`, `/health`.

## Layout
- `project/` Python app (`botd.py` HITL daemon, `run_daily.py`)
- `docker-compose.yml` service `bot` + profile `daily`
- `.env.example` documented keys, empty values
- `LICENSE` MIT

## Constraints for agents
- Do not invent MAX or VK publish paths. They are absent from Zernio.
- Do not commit `.env`, cookies, or secrets. `.env.example` stays empty.
- Do not tell users to publish the raw Pinterest pin.
- This repo is a factory skeleton, not a hosted SaaS and not a Hermes/OpenClaw skill.
